Helo,
Can some explain me how compatible Vampire and Jyhad are?
Here in Germany we are waiting and don´t now nothing about!

Jyhad rules!

Miguel

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
In V:TES, the rules are divided into basic and advanced section. The basic
rules are meant to introduce new players to the game, but the advanced
section is the Jyhad rules with a couple of tweaks. The cards are also
compatible, though a few are tweaked.
